reason: The operator never checks the rolling-updates feature: UpgradeLogicFactory.java:36-42 picks the upgrade logic from spec.update.strategy alone (RecreateOnImageChangeUpgradeLogic when unset, AlwaysRecreateUpgradeLogic for Recreate), and nothing under operator/src/main references rolling-updates or ROLLING_UPDATES. Only the quarkus CLI update-compatibility commands get a feature check (UpdateCompatibilityCheck/UpdateCompatibilityMetadata run()), so the new CAUTION in advanced-configuration.adoc, which says the Operator will fail, is inaccurate.
